component.name: Imagiflume
component.summary: Generate and edit images locally with FLUX, Qwen Image and Fibo

description.p: Imagiflume is a desktop app for local image generation and editing, powered by stable-diffusion.cpp. It runs the models on your own machine: no Python environment, no cloud account and no images leaving the device.

ul.li: Text to image with FLUX, Qwen Image and Fibo presets
Edit with reference images, crops and upscales
A history of every result with chains, search, filters and favorites
A queue with pause, reorder and batch counts
PNG metadata that keeps each image self-describing

description.p: Models and backends are downloaded on first use. The app stays free, with no ads, accounts or paid tiers.

screenshot.caption: Generate and edit images on your own machine
History keeps every result, grouped by the image it came from

description.p: First beta: generation, editing, upscaling, LoRAs and history.
